components.css: .ds-nav{display:flex;gap:2rem;font:500 .95rem Manrope,system-ui,sans-serif}.ds-nav a{position:relative;padding:.4rem 0;color:#5E554B;text-decoration:none}.ds-nav a::after{content:'';position:absolute;left:0;right:0;bottom:0;height:1.5px;background:#D9AF45;transform:scaleX(0);transform-origin:right;transition:transform 320ms cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1)}.ds-nav a:hover,.ds-nav a.is-active{color:#3A332C}.ds-nav a:hover::after,.ds-nav a.is-active::after{transform:scaleX(1);transform-origin:left}

narrative.overview: A bright, freshly cleaned consultório translated to the screen: paper-white and off-white grounds, sand fields that hold whole regions, and one warm yellow that behaves like a smile — rare, curved and kind. Type does the talking: a calm, high-contrast serif for everything that speaks and a clean geometric sans for everything that informs. Photography sits in arch-topped frames.
keyCharacteristics: Paper-white / off-white grounds with full-width sand bands for rhythm.
One warm yellow accent reserved for primary actions, icon details and the smile stroke.
Arch-topped photo frames and pill buttons; 16–24px corners elsewhere.
Thin 1.35px line icons drawn in one family.
Soft, brown-tinted, offset shadows; never hard or colored halos.

rules.name: The One Smile Rule
rules.body: Yellow appears as fills only on actions (primary button, floating WhatsApp) and the CTA band tint; everywhere else it is a detail under 10px or a stroke.

rules.name: The No Black Rule
rules.body: Text is Ink at its darkest; #000 never appears.

rules.name: The Roman Hero Rule
rules.body: The hero headline stays roman; emphasis comes from the smile stroke, not italics. Italic is reserved for quoted patient voices.

rules.name: The Lining Numerals Rule
rules.body: Headings use lining-nums so numbers never drop below the baseline.

dos: Do route every booking action to WhatsApp with a yellow or dark pill.
Do frame photography in arches and keep the sand blob behind the hero portrait.
Do keep text in Ink / Ink Soft and body measure under 62ch.
Do gate hover styles behind (hover: hover) and (pointer: fine) and give every control an :active press.
Do keep entrance motion one-time and content visible by default; respect prefers-reduced-motion.
donts: Don't use pure black (#000) for text or fills.
Don't fill large areas with Smile Yellow; the CTA band uses Soft Smile.
Don't set the hero headline in italic; the smile stroke is the emphasis.
Don't put eyebrow labels above section headings.
Don't mix icon styles; icons are 24px line drawings at 1.35px stroke.
